text:
sara_harrison: Heads-up: we're sunsetting the open-ended Starter free slab in favor of a short, predictable onboarding bundle. 90-day wind-down starting 2026-06-01. Summary and action items below. :loudspeaker:

matt_lee: TL;DR: new onboarding = 7-day trial + one-time $50 credit for new accounts. No change for Dedicated/reserved or enterprise-negotiated credits.

anna_finance: Finance specifics: billing cutover 2026-06-01. For active customers we'll prorate any remaining legacy credits and apply a single invoice credit. No retroactive adjustments.

ops-bot: [Automated] Internal doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/starter-bundle-transition (ops-only)

jessica_support: Support playbook incoming with canned responses and escalation flow. Key message: "Existing credits will be honored or prorated; new onboarding is simpler and time-limited." I'll post playbook to #help by EOD.

marco_marketing: Comms plan: in-console banner + customer email on 2026-05-15; blog explainer on 2026-05-20; FAQ and support snippets same day. Legal will review copy.

olga_engineering: Infra tasks: (1) implement rate-smoothing defaults for new trial accounts; (2) add billing export column "legacy_free_slab_prorated". Staging push planned. Example smoothing config: 

```
# free-trial smoothing config
free_trial: { burst_tokens: 2000, sustained_rpm: 1200, smoothing_window_secs: 60 }
```

sara_harrison: Sales guidance: highlight that Dedicated/reserved customers are unaffected and enterprise credits remain. Sales outreach to top-100 free-slab users with estimated >$2k/mo spend. @matt_lee to prepare list.

matt_lee: I'll produce the export and share with AE leads tomorrow. Also coordinating objection scripts with @jessica_support.

anna_finance: Billing team to produce CSV of affected accounts with prorated credit amounts; ETA 2026-05-10. We'll run a dry-run billing simulation on 2026-05-17.

jessica_support: Draft objection reply: "We understand the change; to ease migration we're providing a one-time $50 self-serve credit and a clear upgrade runbook. For high-usage customers we'll offer account review calls." Sharing draft now.

marco_marketing: Banner copy idea: "Updating free starter benefits to a time-bound onboarding bundle. Existing credits honored. Learn more →" Thoughts?

olga_engineering: We'll instrument a telemetry flag to filter rollout-related errors during day-1. Tagging eng-oncall for the rollout window. Also will ensure metering reports include the new column for exports.

sara_harrison: Recap action items:
- @matt_lee: export top-100 affected list (due TOM)
- @anna_finance: CSV/proration run (due 2026-05-10)
- @jessica_support: publish playbook (EOD)
- @marco_marketing: customer email + banner draft (first draft 2026-05-03)
- @olga_engineering: push staging config + telemetry (staging by 2026-05-05)

sara_harrison: Rationale: predictability for customers, better abuse mitigation, and clearer upgrade paths. Ping legal or product questions to me. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
